question:
Select the option that is best represented by the given Venn diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/677122aa5e14177f1f57704fea48a16cfaaa275e8c1fbdfee5333dd3a6aceaa3.png]
solution:
Given figure are -

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c557e92edf4555781fde4d8bcef007fdabc9570891d51a9d0f7c012216f2378.png] 

**From option 1 - Doctor, Man, Student**

**Some doctor are man, some man are student, some doctor are student.**

So It is the best representation of the venn diagram.

Let A = Doctor, B = Man, C = Student

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21966339b68ead082f5712c47a3e6834ec717684677fca5e5d2d14c90f816539.png] 

 

From option 2 - table, Chair, Furniture

No table is chair, some furniture are table as well as chair. It is not correct representation of the venn diagram.

From option 3 - Gold, silver, ornaments

It is not correct representation of the venn diagram.

From option 4 - Family, Parents, Children

 It is not correct representation of the venn diagram.

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.
